scripts.dev: npm run db:start -w api && concurrently -n api,web,db -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web" "node scripts/db-watchdog.mjs"
scripts.setup: npm install && node -e "require('fs').existsSync('api/.env')||require('fs').copyFileSync('api/.env.example','api/.env')" && npm run db:start -w api && npm run db:deploy -w api
